import React from "react"; import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuPortal, } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"; import { Mail, MessageSquare, ChevronDown, Plus, Calendar, DollarSign, FileText, ClipboardCheck, ListChecks, Users, Link2, Beaker, } from "lucide-react"; import { Button } from "@/components/ui-kit"; import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom"; import { colors } from "@/theme"; /** * Top-right Send ▼ + + Create ▼ dropdowns on the Customer detail page. * Feb-2026 Customer Detail Additions ship. * * All items pre-fill the target flow with the current customer via a * ``?customer_id=`` query param — every existing create route already * respects this convention, so no receiving-side changes are required. * * Feb-2026 · Customer Header Navy Strip * ───────────────────────────────────── * When the parent renders us inside the unified navy command strip * (see ``CustomerDetail.jsx``), it passes ``navy={true}`` — both * trigger buttons then adopt the strip's white-on-navy styling so * they blend with the rest of the strip's controls. Menu content * (the popover) keeps its default (light) styling — spec calls for * only the trigger to live on navy. * * Feb-2026 · Chemistry submenu consolidation * ───────────────────────────────────────── * The standalone "Chemistry" brand-colored dropdown that lived * inline on the customer header row is folded into ``+ Create`` * as a nested submenu labelled "Chemistry…". Both original * options (Chemistry, Chemistry History) are preserved with their * legacy testids so every existing suite keeps resolving. */ export function CustomerActionDropdowns({ customer, onSend, onQuickTask, onSendServiceRecordsLink, navy = false, }) { const navigate = useNavigate(); const cid = customer?.id; const primaryEmail = (customer?.emails || []).find((e) => e.is_primary)?.address || customer?.email || ""; const primaryMobile = (customer?.mobiles || []).find((m) => m.is_primary)?.number_e164 || customer?.phone || ""; // Feb-2026 · Navy strip variant — invert the ``Button`` variant // colors so a white-on-navy trigger reads correctly against // ``colors.nav.bg``. Applied via inline ``style`` overrides so // we don't have to fork the Button primitive. const navyTriggerStyle = navy ? { background: "transparent", color: colors.nav.fg, border: `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.20)`, } : undefined; const navyTriggerClass = navy ? "hover:!bg-white/10 focus:!ring-2 focus:!ring-white/40" : ""; return (
{/* Send ▼ */} onSend?.({ channel: "email", to: primaryEmail })} data-testid="customer-send-email" > Email onSend?.({ channel: "sms", to: primaryMobile })} data-testid="customer-send-sms" > Text (SMS) {/* Task 6 · Feb 2026 — Send service records link. Opens a dedicated modal that dispatches a signed portal auto-login URL to the customer via Email or SMS. */} onSendServiceRecordsLink?.()} data-testid="customer-send-service-records-link" > Service records link {/* + Create ▼ */} navigate(`/jobs/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-visit" > Visit navigate(`/payments/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-payment" > Payment navigate(`/quotes/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-estimate" > Estimate → Quote Creates a quote you can send, sign, and collect on. navigate(`/invoices/new?customer_id=${cid}`)} data-testid="customer-create-invoice" > Invoice onQuickTask?.()} data-testid="customer-create-todo" > To-Do navigate(`/jobs/new?customer_id=${cid}&visit_type=meeting`) } data-testid="customer-create-meeting" > Meeting {/* Feb-2026 · Chemistry submenu — folds the previous standalone "Chemistry" brand-colored dropdown on the customer header row into ``+ Create``. Both original options and their pre-P52 legacy testids are preserved so every existing suite that clicks by testid keeps resolving. */} Chemistry… navigate(`/customers/${cid}/chemistry`)} data-testid="cd-action-chemistry" data-legacy-testid="cd-chemistry" > Chemistry navigate(`/customers/${cid}/chemistry-history`) } data-testid="cd-action-chem-history" data-legacy-testid="cd-chemistry-history" > Chemistry History
); } export default CustomerActionDropdowns;
